hypothesis: Home chat refuses most action requests because app/services/ai/tools/home_write_allowlist.rb omits the write tools for declare incident, paging/escalation, status page, retrospectives, Slack channel actions and Jira, so the model has no tool to call and answers in plain text that it can't.

Web incident chat refuses incident updates, paging and retros (33%/40%/60%) because that surface is deliberately read-only: write tools are filtered out of the surface's tool set (ai_allowed_tools / surface config) and the system prompt tells the model to say web is read-only.

Incident-update refusals (the top category, 34 teams) come mainly from the enable_ai_assistant_required_fields_v2 LaunchDarkly flag being off for most paying teams, which keeps the incident update tool out of the agent's tool set.

A large share of refusals are tool-level denials rather than missing tools: the tool exists but the requesting user lacks the Rootly role/permission, or the confirmation checkpoint expires, recorded as ai_tool_call_events.outcome denied/permission_denied/held and the 1,119 expired ai_pending_checkpoints.

Some refusals are false 'can't do that' replies from the guardrails in config/ai/guardrails.yml (off-topic and empty-context rules) firing on legitimate action requests, so the agent declines even when a matching tool is available on that surface.
